title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery: Keyless Lot Handling in the Reinstatement Expense Payment
content:
Storage lot handling term for vehicles held without a key, applying to the reinstatement expense payment on a Repossession and Collateral Recovery case.

**Rule.** For the reinstatement expense payment, when no key was obtained at recovery, no key replacement fee expense is posted on the case and the class tow equipment is flatbed or medium-duty flatbed, 12.00 is added to every chargeable day; when no key was obtained, no key replacement fee expense is posted on the case and the class tow equipment is wheel-lift, 8.00 is added to every chargeable day; when a key was obtained or a key replacement fee expense is posted on the case, nothing is added.

Class tow equipment: wheel-lift for Recovery Class 1 Passenger Car, Recovery Class 2 Minivan and Crossover and Recovery Class 3 Sport Utility Vehicle; flatbed for Recovery Class 4 Light-Duty Pickup and Recovery Class 5 Heavy-Duty Pickup; medium-duty flatbed for Recovery Class 6 Full-Size Van.

| Key obtained | Key replacement fee expense posted | Class tow equipment | Added to every chargeable day |
|---|---|---|---|
| no | no | flatbed or medium-duty flatbed | 12.00 |
| no | no | wheel-lift | 8.00 |
| no | yes | any | nothing |
| yes | either | any | nothing |

*Illustration (hypothetical):* a keyless Recovery Class 4 Light-Duty Pickup with no key replacement fee posted and 5 chargeable days carries 60.00 of keyless lot handling across those days.
